import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature/src/types/checker/builtin_spl_classes/registry.rs')
t = p.read_text()
old = '''        let unreachable: Vec<&String> = classes
            .keys()
            .filter(|name| !reachable.contains(&php_symbol_key(name)))
            .collect();'''
new = '''        let unreachable: Vec<&String> = classes
            .keys()
            // A `__Elephc`-prefixed class is SYNTHETIC: the prefix cannot appear in PHP source, so
            // no program names it and none needs to — it is registered alongside the class that
            // uses it, and reached through that one.
            .filter(|name| !name.starts_with("__Elephc"))
            .filter(|name| !reachable.contains(&php_symbol_key(name)))
            .collect();'''
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(t.replace(old, new))
print('registry.rs: synthetic classes are excluded, with the reason')
